entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-25
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • dotnet watch: building several projects fails when two of them have the same file name (temporary solution rejects duplicate project names) #57360
  • Split `dotnet_style_prefer_collection_expression` to independently configure + autofix `when_types_loosely_match` and `when_types_exactly_match` #57359
  • dotnet watch (Aspire server): launching a web project fails with "The given key '1021' was not present in the dictionary" when browser tools are disabled #57358
  • Remove the legacy Aspire workload deprecation check from the .NET SDK #57356
  • [CI triage] Microsoft.DotNet.Cli.Utils.Tests Helix work item dead-lettered on Windows x64 VS2026 preview scout queue #57355
  • [Known Build Error] SdkAppHostLayoutTests.AppHostsAreGeneratedPerHostAndTypeLibraryIsIndependent intermittently misses MSBuild apphost regeneration #57354

Closed

  • .net 8 + source generated log messages causes build error: error CS0757: A partial method may not have multiple implementing declarations #50676
  • .NET 11 RC2 regression: Web SDK app referencing a Web SDK library fails in Debug: "scoped css bundles do not have matching endpoints" #56656
  • Missing CA1416 when type has SupportedOSPlatform and member has both SupportedOSPlatform and UnsupportedOSPlatform #51144

PullRequests

Created

  • [dotnet test] Coordinate MTP invocation-lifetime handlers across test modules #57357
  • Expose the generated multi-platform container index digest #57353
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #57352
  • Add scheduled poll fallback to PR labeler #57350

Merged

  • Gate dotnet test --solution device selection on IsTestingPlatformApplication only #57182
  • Add Local static web asset mode for server browser tools #57196
  • Fix dotnet watch diagnostics when device discovery fails #56739
  • Make test run timeout checks deterministic #57351
  • [release/11.0.2xx] Add contextual parallel test output (backport of #57236) #57246
    Area-dotnet test (VSTest), Area-dotnet test (MTP)
  • Fix missing CA1416 for unsupported members of supported types #56756

Updated

  • Add analyzer for mismatched EventSource event IDs #57183
  • Use a build-owned static asset for browser tools activation #56386
  • [wasm] Default R2R inlining/debug-info stripping for browser and wasi RIDs #56411
    arch-wasm
  • Fix source mapping for RID-specific tool packages #57343
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0.2xx' => 'main' #57346
  • Add CA2025 regression coverage for tuple-state task races #56938
  • Bound binary operation values in ValueContentAnalysis #57337
  • [wasm] Require the browser workload for CoreCLR native items #57257
  • Add support for targeting Windows version 28000 #56678
  • [release/11.0.2xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #57347
  • Move `dotnetup` back to Azure's OTel After Requested Fixes #56407
    stale
  • Fix `dotnet build file.cs` with MSBuild logger options #54172
    Area-CLI
  • [dotnet-watch] Compose DOTNET_STARTUP_HOOKS with an existing value instead of replacing it #56541
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #57192
  • [release/11.0.2xx] Backport #57054: Reduce CA1851 and shared dataflow analysis overhead #57342
